verdict.rationale: Pulley is a cap-table and equity-management platform, so letting an agent programmatically draft grants for board approval is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack shows no API or agent-facing surface for creating securities. All OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404, and the only llms.txt found indexes help-center articles rather than offering a way to act on the platform. The stock-option templates and board/investor signature collection that are documented are UI workflows, with no programmatic drafting or approval queue.
